    HOW TO READ EXECUTION RATES
    

      
Order fill incidence counts recorded order IDs with at least one positive fill-ledger row, including orders that were later cancelled after a partial fill.

      
Post-only quote fill rate counts maker and hybrid quote IDs with a positive fill row against non-rejected quote attempts. A hybrid expiry fallback is submitted as a separate taker order and is excluded from this quote rate.

      
Quote lifetime averages closed filled or cancelled post-only quote IDs with valid submitted and terminal timestamps. These are execution diagnostics, not profit or strategy-quality measures.

VIEW PROBABILITY BINS

      

      
The gated hit rate counts only captured, resolved forecasts whose predicted-side probability meets the selected confidence threshold; coverage shows qualifying windows divided by all resolved directional forecasts with confidence data. The nominal 95% Wilson interval on each gated hit rate makes small samples visibly uncertain. A high hit rate is not a trading return or evidence of profitable execution. Direction accuracy uses captured forecasts with resolved outcomes. Paired accuracy compares model and CLOB direction on the same windows; paired Brier and log loss use windows with both probabilities. Lower Brier and log loss are better; log loss penalizes confident misses more heavily, and exact 0/1 inputs are clamped to 1e−12 so the metric remains finite. CLOB-relative Brier skill is 1 − model Brier / CLOB Brier on those same paired windows; positive means lower mean squared probability error, not trading return. Filter model versions before comparing releases; ALL includes older versions. The confidence-gated hit-rate and calibration Wilson intervals are nominal 95% intervals under independent Bernoulli/binomial assumptions; serial dependence is not adjusted, so they can be optimistic. They are not per-market forecast ranges.

      PUBLIC PRINT RADARLargest size-known prints · this active window
      

        
Individual public trade prints captured by this cockpit. No wallet identity or combined position is available.

          
        

        
Waiting for captured prints…

      

    

    
Only locally stored observations are shown. Replay advances one captured 15-second bucket every 0.5 seconds; pause it or scrub manually. Spread is the mean ask minus bid; top size tilt is the mean (best-bid shares − best-ask shares) ÷ their sum. PAIR PARITY plots UP + DOWN midpoint minus $1 only when both outcomes have a sample in the same 15-second bucket; midpoint parity excludes asks and fees and is not executable edge. TRADE FLOW still plots the local BBO tick-rule inference. The stats also compare it with Polymarket's separately reported last-trade BUY/SELL side; that field is not assumed to be a verified taker flag. Missing-size rows remain counted and contribute no notional; the size-coverage card separates missing and older untagged rows. Timestamp-source counts distinguish exchange event time from receive-time fallback. None of these values is a forecast or order signal. Missing buckets remain disconnected. Refreshes every 5 seconds while open.

Net fill flow is signed cash movement after the recorded fee, not position P&L. Order time is creation time and its status is the latest stored state. Fill time is the recorded fill timestamp; the query is bounded to recent/open order IDs and at most 200 fills. Exit time is the sell order creation time. This is not an exchange tick feed or a complete audit replay.
